hypothesis: All-market securities-lending participation, concentration and borrow-fee pressure provide a causal internal-short-pressure state that adds 20-trading-day TWII direction beyond index trend and aggregate FinMind factors.
decision_time: After date-t cash close and publication of date-t securities-lending transactions.
target: TWII close direction from date t to 20 actual Taiwan cash-market trading days later.

data_semantics.point_in_time_universe: Four-digit common stocks present in that source date; no current constituent list.
data_semantics.raw_persistence: Raw security rows are aggregated per source date and are not retained.

features: causal 252-row z-score of active stock count
causal 252-row z-score of log lending volume
causal 252-row z-score of log lending money
causal 252-row z-score of volume-weighted fee rate
causal 252-row z-score of median fee rate
causal 252-row z-score of top-10 stock volume concentration
causal 252-row z-score of five-day log-volume change
causal 252-row z-score of five-day weighted-fee change
method: 1512/252/252 nested ridge-abstention, 20-row purge at fit/validation boundaries, frozen lambda and confidence threshold for each following test block, and effective origins greedily separated by at least 20 actual TWII rows.
formal_run_policy: One execution after all data, feature, grid, baseline, gate and implementation hashes are locked. No subgroup or threshold changes after outcomes are read.
promotion_policy: The lending treatment must pass every absolute gate, significantly beat the strongest simple baseline on identical dates, and significantly beat the index/aggregate control on common dates. Otherwise all lending directional coefficients remain zero.
